pages.title: Four stats and weight
pages.text: An animal only gets a stat panel after a player has fed it: $(bold)satiety / thirst / cleanliness / mood$(), each 0~10, plus weight in kg.$(br2)The panel is inherited by offspring; a baby raised within 8 blocks of an adult that has it gains one when it grows up.$(br2)Animals without a weight standard (cats, dogs) always show 0 and hide that row.$(br2)$(bold)Every vanilla and modded $()$(thing)Animal$()$(bold) subclass counts as keepable by default$(); anything outside the Animal hierarchy can be added by entity id to one of the three feed whitelists in the common config — $(thing)extraFeedAnimals$() for Grass Feed, $(thing)extraSeedFeedAnimals$() for Seed Feed and $(thing)extraMeatFeedAnimals$() for Meat Feed; the list it is in decides which feed it accepts.

pages.title: Two cycles
pages.text: Everything is calculated on the server, in two cycles (the values below are defaults and all configurable):$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Every 5 s (100 ticks)$(): thirst +$(thing)animalRestoreAmount$() (default 1) if water is within 2 blocks; the same for cleanliness while in water or in rain.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Every 30 s (600 ticks)$(): satiety, thirst and cleanliness each -$(thing)animalDecayAmount$() (default 1, never below 0).$(br2)Feeding once: +$(thing)animalFeedSatiety$() satiety (default 3), +$(thing)animalFeedMood$() mood (default 1).

pages.title: Mood and weight
pages.text: Every 30 s:$(br)$(li)All three of satiety / thirst / cleanliness ≥ 7 → mood +1.$(br)$(li)Any of them at 0 → mood -1.$(br)$(li)Otherwise mood is unchanged.$(br2)Weight follows the same check: it gains $(thing)animalWeightStepRatio$() (default 2%) of the standard weight when things are good, loses the same when bad, and is clamped between 0.7 and 1.3 times the standard.

pages.title: Poop and flies
pages.text: Only animals marked eligible after actual player feeding attempt manure every $(thing)animalPoopIntervalTicks$() (default 600 ticks), independently of stat decay. Each attempt uses $(thing)animalPoopChance$() (default 25%; 0 disables it), with at most 6 piles per chunk. Trough feeding restores stats but does not grant manure eligibility.$(br2)$(bold)Placement$(): at least 4 blocks away from troughs and water; when manure is already nearby the new pile is placed next to it, so droppings cluster in one area away from feeding / drinking spots.$(br2)Manure has no collision and cannot be pushed, so it never blocks an animal's pathing.$(br2)When manure plus dead-animal carcasses within 3 blocks reach 3, the animal gets $(bold)fly bite$(): it lasts $(bold)forever$() and caps cleanliness at 5 with an extra -$(thing)animalFlyBiteCleanLoss$() (default 5) on each decay tick. Only flea treatment cures it; removing the manure does not help an already infected animal.

pages.title: Trough behaviour
pages.text: An animal is called to the trough only when its satiety (or thirst) is at or below $(thing)troughNeedThreshold$() (default 5), one animal at a time.$(br2)It does not leave after one bite: it eats one portion every $(thing)troughEatIntervalTicks$() (default 20 ticks), each restoring $(thing)troughRestoreAmount$() (default 5), and $(bold)stays until full (10) or the trough is empty$(). If another AI pulls it away it is re-pathed, giving up only after 30 s without reaching the trough.$(br2)Vanilla / modded animals without a stat panel are also called and get one on their first bite.

pages.title: How spawning runs
pages.text: All natural spawning of this mod's animals is hand-rolled in $(thing)AnimalSpawning$() from $(thing)ServerTickEvent.Post$(); it uses neither $(thing)biome_modifier$(), $(thing)SpawnPlacementRegisterEvent$() nor $(thing)add_spawns$(), so it cannot clash with the parent mod's worldgen. Field mice follow the same pattern in $(thing)MouseSpawning$().$(br2)It ticks every 400 ticks (20 s): if all three animal switches are off it returns immediately. Otherwise it walks every $(thing)ServerLevel$(), checks the $(thing)doMobSpawning$() gamerule, then rolls a 0.35 chance per player.$(br2)Before adding animals, $(thing)animalChunkLimit$() (default 2) limits this mod's land and aquatic animals together per chunk. Field mice have their own cap.

pages.title: Placement and species
pages.text: $(bold)Land$(): a random column 8~32 blocks from the player, resolved with the surface heightmap. The block below must be dirt-like / sand / gravel / mud and the two blocks above must be air; 1~3 animals spawn as a group. Biome picks the species: bamboo jungle → bamboo rat, swamp / mangrove → bullfrog, river / beach → duck, otherwise a random duck, goose, quail, pigeon or turkey.$(br2)$(bold)Water$(): same random column, then $(thing)OCEAN_FLOOR$() gives the bottom block of the water column, which must actually be water. Biome names containing $(thing)ocean$() count as saltwater, everything else as freshwater. Candidates come from the fishing handbook: only entries whose $(thing)entity$() belongs to this mod, filtered by $(thing)habitat$(), preferring entries whose $(thing)biomes$() match - so a new fish joins spawning as soon as its handbook entry exists.

pages.title: Naming animals
pages.text: Sneak-right-click no longer opens the custom animal naming screen, and the server rejects such naming packets. Vanilla name tags still work on animals. The scarecrow's right-click naming screen remains available.
